speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the timeline of your symptoms. Did the flank pain and fever start immediately after you finished your antibiotics for sinusitis, or were they present before you began the treatment? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urine color or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy and urine culture. Have you noticed any blood in your urine or difficulty passing it? REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis Microscopy: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm; Leukocyturia: Present. Urine Culture: Negative. Renal Ultrasound: Not provided.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Patient
text: The sinus symptoms improved, but the flank pain and fever stayed. The rash happened during the antibiotics and then resolved after the change in medication. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pyelonephritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The combination of fever, flank pain, fatigue, and a rash appearing during antibiotic treatment is highly characteristic of this infection, likely complicated by a drug reaction or resistant organism. I have already ordered the necessary urinalysis and renal ultrasound to confirm the diagnosis and guide treatment.
